history_index_audit.scope: supplied episode records only; selected outcome-stratified cases do not estimate the full evaluation or training distribution
history_index_audit.exposure_definition: among nonempty actor histories, count_minus_one_index points to a false _nonzero_mask slot

realized_speed_summary.target_speed_action_mapping: speed_mps = clip((policy_or_executed_action[0] + 1) * 5, 0, 10); intervention inverse a0 = target_mps / 5 - 1

limitations: Cases are the outcome-stratified first eight collision and first four success examples by ascending logical validation seed; this is not a population-rate sample.

The same selected seed appears in multiple phases. The inferential unit is at most one seed-by-phase window, and the two speed arms are paired counterfactual branches from that window; repeated actions within an arm are not independent samples.

The near-terminal anchor is selected three decisions before the baseline terminal event and is therefore aligned using the original baseline trajectory; it is not a deployable trigger known without that trajectory.

Prefix matching covers recorded observation/action hashes and sampled active-actor physical state with live road/lane queries, but not every hidden SUMO internal state, pending departure queue, or future RNG state.

The policy resumes after three normal decisions in the changed state; background actors respond normally. A rescued outcome shows a tested action-and-continuation can differ, not that a bounded residual can achieve or learn that action.
Closest-approach diagnostics are geometric proxies, not a measured true time-to-collision.

The history-index audit uses the model _nonzero_mask rule trajectory[...,0] != 0; a physically valid x=0 point is treated as padding by that same rule. No actor IDs are present in policy observations.
The selected 12 old-checkpoint baselines have zero observed count-minus-one versus true-last mismatch; this does not establish exposure rates elsewhere or evaluate a corrected checkpoint.
Episode raw-step counters do not include exact reset warm-up simulation ticks; reset warm-up count is unavailable.
